Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Nullifies negative effects for 4 turns
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 350%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per Ki Sphere obtained
- Extreme Class allies' ATK 70%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus attacks are
effective against all Types for characters who also
belong to the "Planet Namek Saga" Category
*When there is another "Planet Namek Saga" Category ally
on the team, or when all allies are Extreme Class characters*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Guards all attacks
- Damage reduction rate 65%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking*
- ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
